births.text: Grant Imahara, American television presenter and engineer (died 2020)

pages.title: Grant_Imahara
pages.extract: Grant Masaru Imahara was an American electrical engineer, roboticist, television host and actor. He was best known for his work on the television series MythBusters, on which he designed, built, and operated numerous robots and machines to test myths over the course of the show.

pages.title: Niccolò_Pisilli
pages.extract: Niccolò Pisilli is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Roma and the Italy national team.

pages.title: Jacob_Bethell

pages.title: Hpakant_Township
pages.extract: Hpakant Township is a township of Mohnyin District in Kachin State of northern Myanmar. The administrative centre is Hpakant. The major town is Kamaing.

events.text: Second Libyan Civil War: The Second Libyan Civil War comes to an end as all parties to the 5+5 Joint Libyan Military Commission agree to a ceasefire.

pages.title: Libyan_civil_war_(2014–2020)
pages.description: Multilateral civil war in North Africa
pages.extract: The Libyan civil war (2014–2020), also known as the Second Libyan Civil War, was a multilateral civil war which was fought in Libya among a number of armed groups, but mainly the House of Representatives (HoR) and the Government of National Accord (GNA), for six years from 2014 to 2020.
